x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.b: Labadaba shaashadda filimka iyo hoolka riwaayadaha waxay leeyihiin safaf kuraas ah. Erayadani ma kala saaraan labada.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.c: Screen (shaashad) waa eray ka muhiimsan shaashad filim marka loo eego hoolka riwaayadaha. Waxay noqon kartaa tilmaan kala qaybinaya labada.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.d: Lagu yiraahdo aamus waxaa laga maqli karaa labada goobood.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.explain: Erayada ku habboon labada musharax (safaf kuraas ah, aamusnaan) ma kala saaraan goobaha. Popcorn iyo screen waa tilmaamo ka dhow shaashad filim. Laakiin way adag tahay in gabi ahaanba la dejiyo hal sadar oo keliya.

Macallinku subaxda wuxuu yiraahdaa, "How are you today, Mina?"

Saaxiibkaa Jin wuxuu yiri, "In English, speaking politely is always better. You can just talk that way to everyone."

x-e-e2-07.s.s1.explain: b iyo d waxay ka jawaabaan salaanta oo qofka kale dib u weydiiyaan, sidaas darteed way ku habboon yihiin macallin. a aad bay u caadi tahay c-na waxay u muuqataa mid edeb daran.

x-e-e2-07.s.s2.model.0: Odhashada "I would be delighted to" saaxiib dhow aad bay u adag tahay oo aan dabiici ahayn.
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Waxay siisay sida lala hadlo saaxiib sida tusaale.
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.model.3: Waa yaab in luqad ixtiraam leh lala isticmaalo eey yar.

x-e-e2-06.title: Odhashada 'Give me your pen.' si kala duwan macallinka iyo saaxiib
x-e-e2-06.topic: Erayo edeb leh iyo erayo saaxiibtinimo
x-e-e2-06.goal: Dib u qor isla codsiga sida laba weedhood oo Ingiriisi ah, mid walba oo ku habboon dhegaystaha (macallin/saaxiib).
x-e-e2-06.material: Waxaad u baahan tahay qalin. Weedhii asalka ahayd waa "Give me your pen." Haddii dhegeystuhu yahay macallin, tani waxay u muuqan kartaa mid aad u gaaban oo qallafsan. Dib u qor laba jeer, mar macallinkaaga iyo mar saaxiib dhow.
x-e-e2-06.thinking.0: Dooridda codka iyadoo la raacayo dhegeystaha
x-e-e2-06.thinking.1: Kala saar erayada edebta iyo erayada saaxiibtinimada
x-e-e2-06.prereq.0: Erayada codsi fudud sida please, Can I ~?, Could I ~?
x-e-e2-06.s.s1.prompt: Si edeb leh macallinka uga codso inuu ku amaahiyo qalin. (hal weedh Ingiriisi ah)
x-e-e2-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ka fikir erayada sida 'Could I ~?' marka codsi la samaynayo.
x-e-e2-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sidee ayuu codku isu beddelaa haddii aad ku darto Excuse me ama please?
x-e-e2-06.s.s1.selfAssess.0: Ma yahay cod macallinku ku farxo inuu maqlo?
x-e-e2-06.s.s1.selfAssess.1: Ma ka kooban yihiin erayo codsi sameeya (Could I, May I, please)?
x-e-e2-06.s.s1.modelNote.1: May I waa eray edeb leh.
x-e-e2-06.s.s2.prompt: Markan, si caadi ah saaxiib fasal oo dhow uga codso inuu ku amaahiyo qalin. (hal weedh Ingiriisi ah)
x-e-e2-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ka soo qaad hal eray oo ka mid ah waxa aad macallinka u qortay oo aad u adag saaxiib.
x-e-e2-06.s.s2.hint.1: Geli salaan gaaban ama eray codsi ah oo saaxiibbadu caadi ahaan isticmaalaan.
x-e-e2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma yahay cod saaxiib ku dareemo raaxo?
x-e-e2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Sidee ay uga duwan tahay weedhii aad macallinka u qortay?
x-e-e2-06.s.s2.modelNote.1: Waxay muujisaa saaxiibtinimo mahadnaq la socdo.

x-e-e2-08.title: Hel oo sax weedha aan ku habboonayn sheekada Coco
x-e-e2-08.goal: Shanta weedh dhexdooda, hel midka ka hor imanaya caddaynta hor iyo dambe, oo dib ugu qor sida weedh ku habboon sheekada.
x-e-e2-08.material: Hoos waxaa ku yaal qoraal gaaban oo soo bandhigaya eey, Coco. Hal weedh ma ku habboona weedhaha kale ee qoraalka.
x-e-e2-08.thinking.0: Isbarbar dhig weedhaha si aad u hesho khilaaf
x-e-e2-08.prereq.0: Magac-gaysyo fudud sida weyn, yar, bunni, cadaan
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.prompt: Dooro weedha aan ku habboonayn weedhaha kale ee qoraalka.
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.hint.0: Si gooni ah u ururi sadarrada sharaxaya muuqaalka Coco oo isbarbar dhig.
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.hint.1: Haddii sadarro qaar is khilaafaan, aamin dhinaca leh sadarro badan oo taageera.
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.explain: Sadarrada 2 iyo 3 waxay yiraahdaan Coco aad buu u yar yahay. Sadarka 4 wuxuu yiri Coco waa weyn yahay oo bunni, sidaa darteed wuxuu khilaafaa labadaas sadar. Sadarrada 1 iyo 5 waxay ku habboon yihiin sheekada Coco.
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.prompt: Mar kale u qor weedhaas Ingiriisi si ay ugu habboonaato sheekada Coco.
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir hal xaqiiqo oo ku saabsan Coco oo aan hore loo sheegin.
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.hint.1: Qor weedh gaaban oo ku bilaabata She ama Coco.
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma hubisay in weedhda cusubi aysan khilaafin weedhaha ka horreeya?
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma ka kooban tahay macluumaad cusub oo ku saabsan Coco?
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Waxay bixisaa macluumaad cusub oo ku saabsan Coco.

x-e-e2-09.title: Samee weed aan ku habboonayn qoraal ku saabsan miro oo ka dhig xujo saaxiib
x-e-e2-09.goal: Fahan in weedhaha aan ku habboonayn ay ku xidhan tahay mawduuca, oo samee hal mawduuc iyo hal weedh aan ku habboonayn.
x-e-e2-09.material:
Waxaad samaysaa xujo 'mid ka duwan' aad siiso saaxiib. Marka hore, aan eegno hal tusaale.

I like apples. I like bananas. Grapes are sweet. ?
x-e-e2-09.thinking.0: Dooridda weedho iyadoo mawduuca lagu salaynayo
x-e-e2-09.prereq.0: Weedho fudud sida I like ~. iyo ~ is/are ...
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaan ku habboonayn sida weedha afraad? (Mawduuca: miro)
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.hint.0: Hal erey ku sheeg mawduuca wadaagga ah ee saddexda weedh ee ugu horreeya.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi haddii weedh kasta aan ka tirsanayn mawduucaas.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.a: Peach waa miro, sidaa darteed wuxuu ku habboon yahay mawduuca.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.b: Orange sidoo kale waa miro, sidaa darteed wuu ku habboon yahay.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.c: Carrot miro maaha. Marka mawduuca loo arko 'miro', ku habboon ma aha.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.explain: Saddexda weedh ee ugu horreeya dhammaantood waxay ku saabsan yihiin miro (tufaax, mooska, canab). Carrot waa khudrad, sidaa darteed ku habboon ma aha mawduuca. Haddii aad fidiso mawduuca 'cunto', carrot sidoo kale wuu ku habboonaan karaa. Haddii uu ku habboon yahay waxay ku xidhan tahay waxa aad go'aansato inuu mawduuca yahay.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.prompt: Samee xujo aad siiso saaxiib. (1) Saddex weedh oo Ingiriisi ah oo ku habboon hal mawduuc, (2) hal weedh oo aan ku habboonayn (kan afraad), (3) qor jawaabta dhammaadka, sida "Odd one: 4."
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Go'aami hal mawduuc (xayawaan, dugsi, cunto, iwm.) oo marka hore qor saddex weedh mawduucaas.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Qor weedh mawduuc kale ah sida kan afraad, oo ku dar 'Odd one: 4.'
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma mawduuca saddexda weedh ee ugu horreeya waa hal oo cad?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma weedha afraad waa mawduuc kale laakiin qaabkiisu isku mid yahay?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Marka saaxiibkaa xalliyo, tilmaan noocee ah ayuu u isticmaali doonaa si uu u helo jawaabta?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.modelNote.0: Hadal ku saabsan cunto ayaa lagu qasay sheeko ku saabsan bisad.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Weed ku saabsan shabeel ayaa lagu qasay sheeko ku saabsan dugsi.

x-e-e2-10.title: Samee hal su'aal oo hesha macluumaadka maqan ee fariin qoraal ah
x-e-e2-10.topic: Weydiinta hal su'aal oo waxtar leh
x-e-e2-10.goal: Hel macluumaadka aan fariinta ku jirin, dooro hal su'aal oo ugu waxtar badan, oo naftaada samee su'aal xaalad cusub.
x-e-e2-10.material:
Saaxiibkaa Sora ayaa kuu diray qoraal.

"Let's play tomorrow! Bring a ball."

Waxaad rabtaa inaad tagto, laakiin dhowr shay ma ogaan kartid.
x-e-e2-10.thinking.1: Isbarbar dhigga sida su'aalaha waxtar u leeyihiin
x-e-e2-10.thinking.2: Helitaanka macluumaadka aad u baahan tahay hal su'aal
x-e-e2-10.prereq.0: Erayada su'aalaha sida When, Where, What time
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal su'aal oo ugu waxtar badan oo aad weydiiso Sora.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.hint.0: U kala qaybi fariinta laba tiir: waxa ay horey kuu sheegayso iyo waxa aadan weli ogeyn.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir waxa aad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato si aad u kulantaan.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.a: Su'aashani waxay weydiisaa laba macluumaad isla mar: meesha iyo waqtiga, labaduba waa lagama maarmaan kulanka.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.b: Fariintu horey ayay u tidhi keen kubbad. Nooca kubbadda way fiicnaan lahayd in la ogaado, laakiin ma bixiso macluumaadka kale ee loo baahan yahay.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.c: Waad baran kartaa meesha, laakiin weli ma ogtid waqtiga. Hal shay oo keliya ayaa la xaliyey.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.d: Haddii Sora jecel yahay kubbado maaha macluumaad loo baahan yahay kulanka.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.explain: Fariintu waxay leedahay "berri" iyo "keen kubbad" oo keliya, waxaana ka maqan meesha iyo waqtiga. Su'aal weydiisa laba macluumaad isla mar ayaa ugu waxtar badan. Su'aal weydiisa meesha oo keliya waxay ka tagtaa waqtiga oo aan la ogeyn, su'aalaha ku saabsan nooca kubbadda ama dhadhanka Sora na macluumaad lagama maarmaan ah kulanka maaha.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.prompt: Waa xaalad cusub. Aabbe wuxuu yiri: "We'll go on a trip on Saturday." Qor hal su'aal Ingiriisi ah si aad u hesho macluumaadka maqan ee ugu muhiimsan. (Isticmaal hal calaamad su'aal oo keliya)
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.hint.0: Kala saar waxa aad horey uga ogtahay hadalka Aabbe (Saturday, trip) iyo waxa aadan ogeyn.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.hint.1: Dooro mid ka mid ah waxyaabaha aadan ogeyn oo samee su'aal ku bilaabata Where ama What time.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma su'aashaydu waxay weydiisaa macluumaad aan hadalka Aabbe ku jirin?
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma jawaabta su'aashaasi waxay caawinaysaa diyaarinta safarka?
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Weydiinta waqtiga sidoo kale way fiican tahay.
